debate.key_bull_argument: MACD/PPO crossovers and rising RSI show early momentum with intact long-term EMA 50/200 structure, offering a contrarian entry in fear-zone sentiment (VIX crisis).
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX 459.2, FOMC in 1 day, flat yield curve, rising USD), price below key MAs (SMA 21, 200 EMA), weak trend strength (ADX 23.18), Ichimoku cloud resistance, and high earnings risk in 48 days create compounded uncertainty that outweighs early momentum signals.
